title: Coherent cocones for a globally compatible tensor comparison
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $i_0\le i$, and $B_0,C_0$ commutative $F(i_0)$-algebras with an algebra map $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$. Put $B_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C_j=F(j)\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$, $B=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$. Let $P,Q$ be commutative rings with $Q$ a $P$-algebra. Give $B_i$ and $B$ $P$-algebra structures such that their canonical map $\mu_B:B_i\to B$ is $P$-linear. Let $\zeta:B\otimes_PQ\to C$ be a ring map whose restriction to $B$ is $\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0$. Let $\psi:B_i\otimes_PQ\to C_i$ be a ring map whose restriction to $B_i$ is $\mathrm{id}_{F(i)}\otimes\varphi_0$ and such that $\mu_C\psi=\zeta(\mu_B\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q)$ for the canonical $\mu_C:C_i\to C$. Set $J=\{j\in I\mid i\le j\}$. There exist $P$-algebra structures on $B_j$, ring diagrams $D,E:J\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ in the common universe, a natural transformation $\alpha:D\to E$, equivalences $d_j:D(j)\simeq B_j\otimes_PQ$ and $c_j:E(j)\simeq C_j$, cocones $c_D,c_E$, and equivalences $d_\infty:c_D.\mathrm{pt}\simeq B\otimes_PQ$, $c_\infty:c_E.\mathrm{pt}\simeq C$, with the following properties. The canonical maps $\mu_j:B_j\to B$ are $P$-linear; under these equivalences the source cocone legs are $\mu_j\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q$ and the target cocone legs are the canonical $C_j\to C$. For each $j\le k$, the source transition is $\beta_{kj}\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q$, where $\beta_{kj}:B_j\to B_k$ is $P$-linear and is the canonical tensor transition; the target transition is the canonical $C_j\to C_k$. For every $j$, $c_\infty c_E.\iota_j\alpha_j=\zeta d_\infty c_D.\iota_j$; every transition square of $\alpha$ is a pushout; and $c_j\alpha_jd_j^{-1}$ restricts on $B_j$ to $\mathrm{id}_{F(j)}\otimes\varphi_0$. No colimit universal property or bijectivity of $\zeta$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat), proof of (3), construction of the maps Ψ; Tag 00DD, tensor products commute with colimits. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02JO and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00DD on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Apply the local tensor comparison construction, which does not use ζ, he or hlim, to obtain the canonical diagrams, cocones, pushout squares and constant Q-coordinate.

For each stage conjugate the component and cocone leg by d_j inverse. Use tensor ring-hom extensionality. On the B_j inclusion, the local left-compatibility identity and target leg identity reduce the equality to μC_j φ_j = φ∞ μB_j; prove this by induction on pure tensors using the specified canonical μB_j. Apply he. On the Q inclusion, the constant Q-coordinate and hlim evaluated at 1 tensor q give the equality. Finally evaluate at d_j(z), cancel the equivalence, and use the source-leg identity to recover the stated comparison identity.

proof_origin.place: Lean reduction: local tensor system plus proved global compatibility by checking the two tensor inclusions.

theorem exists_comparison_tensor_cocones
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (ζ : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q →+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (he : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      ζ.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId ↥(colimit F) ↥(colimit F)) φ₀).toRingHom)
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPi : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (μB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P] (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      μB.toRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
    (ψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ((↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q) →+* (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (hψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ψ.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom)
    (hlim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp ψ =
        ζ.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map μB (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∃ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∃ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}) (α : D ⟶ E),
          ∃ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∃ (c : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
              ∃ (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E),
                ∃ (dLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aP
                    ↥cD.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q)
                  (cLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    ↥cE.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
                  ∃ (μs : ∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    (μs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    dLim.toRingHom.comp (cD.ι.app j).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (μs j) (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                        (d j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aPs k
                    ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                        (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
                      (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
                        β.toRingHom =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
                            (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                      (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
                        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                          (d j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    cLim.toRingHom.comp (cE.ι.app j).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
                    (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ j : J, cLim.toRingHom.comp
                    ((cE.ι.app j).hom.comp (α.app j).hom) =
                    ζ.comp (dLim.toRingHom.comp (cD.ι.app j).hom)) ∧
                  (∀ {j k} (r : j ⟶ k), IsPushout (α.app j) (D.map r)
                    (E.map r) (α.app k)) ∧
                (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  ((c j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)).comp
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                      (A := ↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      φ₀).toRingHom)
